description: This file defines the interface for a socket waiter module in C, including types, enums, function prototypes, and macros for managing socket event waiting, callbacks, and thread synchronization within the Starboard platform.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterCreate
methods.description: Creates and returns a new socket waiter for the current thread.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a socket waiter and removes all registered sockets.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterAdd
methods.description: Adds a socket to the waiter with specified interests and callback.

methods.name: SbPosixSocketWaiterAdd
methods.description: Adds a socket (POSIX-specific) to the waiter with callback.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterRemove
methods.description: Removes a socket from the waiter.

methods.name: SbPosixSocketWaiterRemove
methods.description: Removes a POSIX socket from the waiter.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterWait
methods.description: Waits indefinitely on registered sockets, calling callbacks when ready.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterWaitTimed
methods.description: Waits with a timeout, returning the reason for exit.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterWakeUp
methods.description: Wakes up the waiter from any thread.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterIsValid
methods.description: Checks if a socket waiter handle is valid.
